segments.caption: A person offers a coin to a crow on a paved patio, drawing the attention of a nearby German Shepherd dog, which watches curiously as the crow approaches and pecks at the offered treat.
A German Shepherd lies calmly on a paved patio as a black crow approaches, pecking at a white ball nearby, creating a quiet, curious standoff between the dog and the bird.
A black crow cautiously approaches a pale yellow ball on a paved patio, while a German Shepherd dog lies nearby, observing the bird’s movements with a calm, watchful demeanor.

A German Shepherd lies calmly on a paved patio, its attention fixed on a small, round food item near its paw, while a black crow stands nearby, beak open and seemingly vocalizing or confronting the dog, creating a tense standoff between the two animals.

A German Shepherd lies patiently on a paved patio, a small white ball at its paws, while a black crow stands nearby, repeatedly pecking at the ball and appearing to try to steal it from the dog's reach. The dog watches the crow with a calm, tolerant demeanor, occasionally shifting its head and licking its lips, seemingly unfazed by the bird's persistent attempts.
A German Shepherd lies calmly on a paved patio, watching as a black crow approaches and pecks at a small, light-colored ball on the ground before flying away, leaving the dog and the ball behind.
A small yellow ball rests on a paved patio as a dog lies nearby, then a black cat swiftly darts under a white plastic chair before disappearing from view.
A black bird pecks at food being offered by a hand through the bars of a blue metal cart, while a white plastic chair and a pet carrier sit nearby on a paved patio.
A black bird walks purposefully across a paved patio, following a small white ball, before pausing near stacked plastic chairs and potted plants to investigate the object.

A black crow pecks at a small white object on a paved patio near a stack of white plastic chairs, then a person’s hand briefly enters the frame holding the object. The camera then pans to reveal a German Shepherd dog walking away on the same patio, moving past a discarded can.

A German Shepherd dog walks along a paved outdoor path, moving past potted plants and buckets, with a small black bird briefly visible nearby. The dog’s movement is steady and purposeful, and the camera follows closely, capturing its head and body as it proceeds through the garden area.
A German Shepherd dog walks across a paved outdoor patio, its attention focused on a small white ball it nudges with its nose and paw, while potted plants and buckets are visible in the background.
A German Shepherd dog cautiously steps back from a small white ball on a paved patio, allowing a crow to approach and investigate the object before walking away.
A black crow walks across a paved patio, approaches a small white ball, pecks at it briefly, then walks away under a white plastic chair, disappearing behind it.

A small black bird walks across a paved courtyard, moving from right to left past a white plastic chair and toward a green trash bin, with various household items like a pet carrier and brooms visible in the background.

A small black animal, likely a cat, is seen crouching near the base of a wall in a paved backyard, then slowly moves out of view behind a green trash bin as the camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the cluttered outdoor space with stacked chairs and pet carriers.
